info.prompt: The command center of a cybernetic cathedral, where the charge meter is a floating reliquary of gilded bone and crackling energy nodes—each Farkle makes it hemorrhage electric-magenta static into the void, while successful charges thrum with cyan resonance, building toward a climax where the dice explode into a fractal storm of crystalline shards and golden synaptic filaments, the camera spiraling through layers of bio-mechanical arches as hacker overlays project DNA helixes and ancient rune matrices across every surface.
